name: type I restriction-modification system
description: Recognition, host protection and restriction, all three required.

name: type I-E CRISPR-Cas protein machinery
description: Cascade surveillance and Cas3 interference, with spacer acquisition accessory. The CRISPR array itself is outside what protein markers can evidence.

name: mer operon mercury detoxification
description: Reduction of Hg(II) to Hg(0) by MerA, required, with metal delivery, mercury-responsive induction and organomercurial lysis accessory.

name: glutathione-dependent glyoxalase mechanism
description: Glyoxalase I and glyoxalase II are both required to convert methylglyoxal to D-lactate and regenerate glutathione.

name: complete superoxide-to-water detoxification
description: One superoxide-removal system and one hydrogen-peroxide-removal system are both required.
